thresholds.tau_source: stated (the repository's v16 value), not fitted on any rows
thresholds.calibration_split: train (a sample of 3523 training sentences, rng 1234+seed) + the CALIBRATION half of the held-out formulations (166 sentences, splits calibration_*), disjoint from the reported half (rule 25)
thresholds.rule: FITTED: per role, the threshold that maximises the balanced present / absent accuracy on the calibration rows (judgment 752853c §2); the pooled midpoint of the same rows is kept as thresholds_pooled_midpoint, the comparison
thresholds.presence_margin: |presence ratio - threshold| (ratio units), on the wire as _presence_margin.<role> (SOP Lang keys carry one dot); the role's _margin = min(identity margin, presence margin): a near-threshold reading abstains

thresholds_training_rows_only.calibration_split: train (a sample of 3523 training sentences, rng 1234+seed); never the scored rows (rule 25)
